properties.title: General Warning
properties.body:
[South-eastern Baltic] POLISH NAV WARN 258/26
SOUTH-EASTERN BALTIC. N OF WLADYSLAWOWO
THE METEOROLOGICAL BUOY OWF "BALTYK 3" HAS DRIFTED FROM ITS CORRECT POSITION.
THE CURRENT POSITION IS: 55-13.214N; 018-48.92E.
PARTICULAR ATTENTION RECOMMENDED.
CAUTION ADVISED.
